messages:
Jordan M: Hey @people-ops — quick heads up: there's overnight and early-morning construction next door starting today (jackhammers 7am–11am, loud power tools later). It's been really hard to concentrate on deep work and I missed a few syncs this morning because I had to step away. I'm worried this will affect my performance goals if it keeps up. Can we discuss temporary accommodations? Prefer confidential handling.

Maria (People Ops): Hi Jordan — thanks for flagging, and I'm sorry you're dealing with this. We can absolutely help. Two quick Qs: would you prefer temporary remote days, flexible start/end times to avoid peak noise, or equipment support (ANC headphones/hotel stipend)? I can DM you the formal accommodation request form so we can document it and loop in manager as needed.

Jordan M: Thanks Maria. Flexible start times + a couple WFH days this week would help most. ANC headphones might help but not sure yet. Yes please DM the form — I want minimal people involved and confidentiality is important.

PeopleOpsBot: :white_check_mark: Case created: AC-2026-1127. Maria will follow up within 1 business day.

Alex H (Team Lead): Jordan, I can cover the 9am syncs this week and take on the urgent triage if anything pops. Please don't worry about perf for this short period — we'll note the coverage. I support whatever accommodations Maria recommends. :thumbsup:

Maria (People Ops): @Jordan M sending DM now with the secure form link and next steps. Form link: https://redwood.hr/accom-form (private). High-level process: 1) employee fills the form (brief description + duration requested), 2) People Ops reviews + requests any manager input, 3) we propose interim accommodations (often same-day), 4) finalize and log confidentially in HR case system.

Jordan M: Got the DM, filling it out now. One note: would prefer no email threads that name the specific reason — manager ok to be told "temporary schedule adjustment for a private accommodation" if possible.

Maria (People Ops): Absolutely — we can keep the reason high-level in manager communications. If you prefer, we can redact details from calendar invites and only share necessary schedule changes. Also offering options: a) 2 WFH days this week + shift start to 11am during heavy noise window, b) trial ANC headphones shipping same-day, c) temporary hotel/workspace stipend for up to 3 nights if noise persists. Which would you like us to prioritize?

Jordan M: Let's try option a first (2 WFH days + later start) and ship headphones as a backup. Appreciate the confidentiality.

Sam L: On the manager side — I'll log the manager acknowledgement once Jordan submits. I'll coordinate coverage for the backlog and mark the performance tracker to exclude this week from any deep-work metrics. Happy to add a calendar block for "focus later start" so teammates know availability.

Alex H (Team Lead): I'll add a note to the oncall rota to avoid assigning Jordan to A/B interviews during noisy windows.

Maria (People Ops): Great — I've updated case AC-2026-1127: requested accommodations = 2 WFH days this week, flexible start (11am) during noise days, ANC headphones pending. Shipping address confirmed via DM. Manager notification will state: "approved temporary schedule adjustment (confidential)." Will check back in 7 days to reassess.

Jordan M: Thank you all — this is a huge help. Really appreciate the quick response and the confidentiality. :pray:

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check-in in 7 days for case AC-2026-1127.
